--
-- Table structure for table `banks`
--

CREATE TABLE `banks` (
  `id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `bank_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `cheque_image_path` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `offset_top` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `offset_left` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- --------------------------------------------------------

--
-- Table structure for table `bank_transactions`
--

CREATE TABLE `bank_transactions` (
  `id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `tran_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `transaction_remarks` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `chq_ref_no` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `value_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `withdrawal` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `deposit` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `closing_balance` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `note` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `marketing_person` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- --------------------------------------------------------

--
-- Table structure for table `bank_transaction_client`
--

CREATE TABLE `bank_transaction_client` (
  `id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `bank_transaction_id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `client_id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- --------------------------------------------------------

--
-- Table structure for table `bank_transaction_invoice`
--

  `invoice_no` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

--
-- Table structure for table `blank_invoices`
--

CREATE TABLE `blank_invoices` (
  `id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `booking_id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL,
  `client_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `marketing_person` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `invoice_no` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reference_no` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `invoice_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `letter_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `name_of_work` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `bill_issue_to` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `client_gstin` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `address` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `total_amount` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `discount_percent` decimal(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `discount_amount` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `after_discount` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `cgst_percent` decimal(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `cgst_amount` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `sgst_percent` decimal(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `sgst_amount` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `igst_percent` decimal(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `igst_amount` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `round_off` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `payable_amount` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `invoice_type` enum('tax_invoice','proforma_invoice') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tax_invoice',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- --------------------------------------------------------

--
-- Table structure for table `password_reset_tokens`
--

CREATE TABLE `password_reset_tokens` (
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `token` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- --------------------------------------------------------

--
-- Table structure for table `payment_settings`
--

CREATE TABLE `payment_settings` (
  `id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `instructions` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `bank_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `account_no` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `branch` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `branch_holder_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ifsc_code` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pan_code` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pan_no` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `gstin` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `upi` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by` bigint(20) UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by` bigint(20) UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- --------------------------------------------------------

--
-- Table structure for table `payroll_cycles`
--

CREATE TABLE `payroll_cycles` (
  `id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `month` tinyint(3) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `year` smallint(5) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `processed_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `locked_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `gross_total` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `deduction_total` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `net_total` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- --------------------------------------------------------

--
-- Table structure for table `payroll_entries`
--

CREATE TABLE `payroll_entries` (
  `id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `payroll_cycle_id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `employee_id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `gross_amount` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `leave_deductions` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `other_deductions` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `net_amount` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `status` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `payout_due_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `payout_released_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `remarks` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `meta` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`meta`)),
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- --------------------------------------------------------

--
-- Table structure for table `permissions`
--

CREATE TABLE `permissions` (
  `id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `department_id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL,
  `permission_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

--
-- Table structure for table `vouchers`
--

CREATE TABLE `vouchers` (
  `id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `created_by` bigint(20) UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL,
  `approved_by` bigint(20) UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL,
  `purpose` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `attachment` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `payment_status` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unpaid',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

  `reference` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `payment_month` date NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
